title: The Bear and the Travellers
summary: Two travelers swore mutual defense against all perils. Entering a forest, a giant bear charged out of the brush....
full_text:
Two travelers swore mutual defense against all perils. Entering a forest, a giant bear charged out of the brush.

One traveler scrambled up a tall tree, thinking only of himself. The other, unable to climb, threw himself flat upon the ground, holding his breath and feigning death, for bears touch no corpse.

The bear sniffed his ears, nose, and lips, and lumbered away into the hills.

The man in the tree climbed down and asked with a laugh: "What did the bear whisper in your ear?"

"He gave me sound advice," replied the companion: "never travel with a comrade who deserts you in the hour of danger!"
moral: Adversity tests the sincerity of friendship.
